D-grouse-atv-0090.name: 330 m E of Sowsap Creek
D-grouse-atv-0090.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
D-grouse-atv-0090.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Unnamed); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
5 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 8 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).
private land only, with the landowner's permission

plan: Drive: from Merritt, about 194 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.50602, -118.78645, where the truck road ends (Unnamed); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 730 m to the start. Ride: the Porcupine Road stretch, 3.5 km one way. About 70 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-25, Region 8. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.
